fns.desc: crypto_csr_verify() calls pkey = X509_REQ_get_pubkey((X509_REQ *)csr); which returns a new EVP_PKEY reference the caller must free, but pkey is never freed on either the success path (return (struct crypto_csr *)csr;) or the fail: path (X509_REQ_free(csr); return NULL;) -- a genuine EVP_PKEY leak on every call where the CSR has a parseable public key. CSR data originates from untrusted/relayed protocol input (e.g. DPP enrollment flows), making this an externally-triggerable leak.
